title: Official External Acquisition Materialization
goals: Define the host-to-runner materialization contract for external acquisition actions.
Keep raw acquisition material out of browser submissions, task input/output, diagnostics, and admin responses.
Bind materialization to approved action context, audit, idempotency, runner profile, and short-lived host policy.
Prove the contract through Nako host tests and official fixture runner tests before implementing Transmission.
non_goals: qBittorrent, aria2, ed2k, or HTTP downloader implementation
Browser raw URL or password resubmission
